_about: Rung vocabulary + colour values for Sharket 3.29 Ruthless (CN). Every pairing carries its measured WCAG contrast and names the plate it speaks against (handbook §7). Prose twin: 'Theme Proposal 3.29.dc.html' — run the consistency check over both.

contrast_floors.dark_plate_text: >= 4.5:1 vs its own plate (R3/R4 dark tints and black)
contrast_floors.bright_or_white_plate_text: >= 3.0:1 at FontSize 45 — the measured band: house T0 4.00, FilterBlade vermilion 3.39, Sharket gems 3.14; the plate is the extreme and size carries the rest
contrast_floors.border: >= 3.0:1 vs the plate it sits on
contrast_floors.note: If a pairing fails, one of the two values is in the wrong band. Contrast-raising is not a remedy (handbook §1).

rungs.test_ch: 点击之前你会先截图发给朋友。

rungs.test_en: You stop what you are doing immediately, even mid-fight.
rungs.test_ch: 无论在做什么都立刻停下，哪怕正在战斗。

rungs.test_ch: 你会停下脚步，横穿屏幕去捡它。
rungs.recipe: Hue families: WHITE text on the FAMILY plate, WHITE border, icon 1 Yellow (border + icon carry the rank over R3). Light-hue families: black on bright plate. House R0/R1 white plate stays the house’s alone.

rungs.test_en: You pick it up if it is on your path. You never turn around for it.
rungs.test_ch: 顺路一定捡，但绝不回头。
rungs.recipe: Hue families: family colour on the family's DARK TINT (tint = colour x 0.19). Currency: TextColor 0 0 0 on its bright plate 255 165 0 — the plate walks, the text stays black.

rungs.recipe: Hue families: family colour on PURE BLACK 0 0 0 255. Currency: TextColor 0 0 0 on the classic tan plate 170 158 130.
rungs.contrast: currency 7.91 vs 170 158 130, gems black-on-cyan 6.69 FS43, allflame black-on-hue 6.26 FS43, corpses 6.32

rungs.test_en: You pick it up only on a dedicated collecting trip. Otherwise it is ambient information.
rungs.test_ch: 只在专门收集时才捡，平时只是背景信息。
rungs.recipe: Hue families: same as R4 with TextColor alpha 204 (80%); plate stays SOLID 0 0 0 255. Currency: NO style lines at all — the game paints the label (absent-key rule, §6).
rungs.contrast: gems cyan on 27 51 52 = 4.26, corpses 4.27, currency game default. Allflame has NO R5 — league currency never goes ambient.

rung_rules.assignment: A rung is assigned by the test, never by rank within a category. Categories map their tiers onto the shared scale; gaps are normal (gems has no R0 — omit, never invent).
rung_rules.sharing: Same rung = same look, in every category. Target: most (text, plate) pairs shared across categories, FilterBlade-style; a private pair needs a reason.
rung_rules.merge_trap: Several tiers may share one rung ON PURPOSE, but a rung-keyed change silently merges them (§6). Re-tiering decides which tiers share; the theme never does.
rung_rules.first_task: Visible clarity first, hue variant second (author). Value is carried by the luminance gap — one side of every pairing at an extreme; hue only names the family.

family_count: Hold 12. Corpses joins (13), Tainted vaal-red joins (14). Allflame joins for the league and retires (15 during league only). Scarab lime / harvest emerald re-colour existing families, not new slots. Ceiling test for any future add: passes §1 at all four rungs AND sits >= 10° from band neighbours OR differs by >= 30 saturation points.
icon_floor: Rung-keyed, not category-keyed: icons at R0-R2 only (R0 Red 0, R1 Red 0, R2 Yellow 1), plus safety-net catch-alls at White 2. R3-R5 carry none. The floor becomes 'share of blocks at R0-R2 + nets' — measure it; it lands well under FilterBlade's 70% and under today's 64%.
